title: The process died after Save. Resume made a second draft.

steps.label: Start the graph and save one draft

verification.summary: A separate read-only process found exactly one matching draft after the first process exited with code 73, before the node returned. This checks the saved draft, not graph completion.

steps.label: Restart the process and resume the same graph thread

verification.summary: Independent readback: 2 matching drafts; 2 node attempts. Expected one draft for this logical operation. Resume returned normally, but created a duplicate. This fixture intentionally exercises unsafe replay.
